final_sql: SELECT Episode, Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY CAST(Rating AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 3
answer:
The three highest-rated episodes in the `TV_series` table are:

| Rank | Episode | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A Love of a Lifetime | 5.8 |
| 2 | Friendly Skies | 5.3 |
| 3 | Game Three | 4.4 |

I took "rating" to mean the `Rating` column in `TV_series`. It's stored as text, so I cast it to a number before sorting. Otherwise values like "10.0" would sort below "9.0".

args.sql: SELECT Episode, Rating FROM TV_series ORDER BY CAST(Rating AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 3
